statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. The listed Filebeat versions 9.5.0 and 9.5.1 contain the upstream fix; Scout reports them because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats module PURLs.

CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. The listed Filebeat versions 8.19.19, 8.19.20, 9.3.8, 9.4.4, and 9.4.5 contain the upstream fix; Scout reports them because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats module PURLs.
